title: Asphalt 3: Street Rules
statusNote: Language menu, attract demo, menus and an Instant Play race in landscape, with correct 3D, at 11 to 13 fps on a fast laptop. No sound: its sound is not in a format the web build decodes. The dump is a community release without signatures, which the N-Gage application refuses, so the player installs the game directly.
notes: No sound: the game's audio is compressed, and the web build plays only plain PCM sound.
The phone is turned to landscape by the game, 320×240.

controls.source: Watched in play during the bring-up: the language, sound and menu screens, and an Instant Play race.
